title: quant-kernel-int8-fp8-smoothquant-dequant-fusion-kvcache-scheduling-batching
author: Asha Rao
description: Motivation: Improve quantized (INT8/FP8) inference throughput and tail latency by reducing redundant dequant/quant copies and exposing fused dequant+matmul execution paths while ensuring KV cache correctness and stable continuous batching behavior. This changeset introduces a fused dequant path for int8/FP8 kernels (smoothquant-aware), scheduler hints to favor fused kernels for short sequences, and KV-cache aware batching adjustments so we don't degrade streaming/step-latency workloads. Summary of changes and rationale: 1) New fused kernels: adds fused_dequant_matmul_{int8,fp8}_smoothquant variants that accept packed scale/params and write directly into compute buffers to avoid an intermediate full-precision tensor allocation. This reduces memory bandwidth and improves throughput on Ampere and Hopper-class hardware. 2) Dequant fusion registry: runtime chooses fused path when model metadata reports smoothquant-compatible layout or when runtime quant flags are enabled. Non-compatible models fall back to the existing path. 3) KV-cache integration: KV writeback paths now preserve quant metadata and avoid an extra dequant when caching key/value shards. Added lightweight header to cached KV pages to allow safe replay of fused kernels on subsequent steps. 4) Scheduler hints and continuous batching: Added a kernel_hint flag to the request scheduling layer to prefer fused kernels for low-seq, high-concurrency workloads; continuous batching respects the hint and will break batches that would force expensive dequantations mid-batch. 5) Safety & feature gate: the fused kernels are behind a runtime feature flag (quant.fused_kernels=true) and automatically disabled under telemetry-detected numerical regressions. 6) Tests & benchmarks: unit tests for kernel selection, end-to-end integration tests with streaming/chat demos, new perf harness jobs (A100/H100/T4) that show wins. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-8241) - [x] Kernel implementation and unit tests - [x] Scheduler integration and e2e tests - [x] KV cache metadata format bump with migration tests - [x] Perf runs and numbers attached - [x] Feature-flag and rollback safe - [x] Docs/console flag added to runtime docs Changes are conservative by default; the feature is off for existing tenants unless enabled by ops or matched by model metadata. See release_notes for high-level impact and rollout guidance.
commits: 3 commits: (1) Implement fused_dequant_matmul kernels and basic unit tests; (2) Integrate kernel registry and scheduler hints; (3) KV-cache metadata and migration + perf tuning & docs.
review_thread: Ben: Great perf wins in the A100 run but can we please add an assert that the cached KV header is backward-compatible? Asha: Added migration shim and a unit test asserting older pages are accepted with a warning. Maya: Concern about numerical regressions on edge cases with FP8; requested a small randomized tolerance check across synthetic prompts. Asha: Added regression detector that runs nightly and gates rollout; added the requested tolerance tests. Luis: Approved after seeing stable 95p latency and no increase in mem usage on H100 runs. CI: initial CI failed on macOS build due to a missing cmake flag (fixed in commit 2). Final CI: all green. Merge decision: squash-merge after approval and perf verification.
release_notes: Introduces fused dequant+matmul kernels for INT8 and FP8 (smoothquant-aware) behind the feature flag quant.fused_kernels. Expected improvements: 15-35% throughput uplift and 5-12% P95 latency reduction on A100/H100 for short-sequence, high-concurrency workloads. Backward-compatible KV cache metadata migration included. Feature disabled by default; enable per-tenant via runtime flag or automatic selection when model metadata indicates smoothquant compatibility.
